Why Kick was missing before: the original five-file Pre-Alpha bundle has no kick atlas. That does not mean Kick art does not exist. The authentic V3 Spartan Kick, with its original normal lighting, exists on Graphics 3A draft #825. It is included here as experimental art under visual review, not a claim of Pre-Alpha integration or Main approval.

Knockdown / Fall V2 is the true original Blender pose source from draft #788; the source image here is present unchanged in the parent candidate #825. Unsupported Combat states (light/heavy attacks, parry, block, stun, death) still lack these authored Silver animations and use honest Combat visuals in the game.
